item.question: Why are prime numbers important when discussing hypotheses like RH?
item.answer: Prime numbers are fundamental building blocks of arithmetic, and their distribution has deep implications for various fields such as cryptography, numerical analysis, and theoretical computer science. Understanding hypotheses like RH can lead to breakthroughs in predicting how primes occur within natural numbers.
